name: NestJS
subtitle: Structured Node.js framework
creator: Kamil Myśliwiec
description: A TypeScript framework for building large Node.js back ends with modules, controllers, providers and dependency injection. Its architecture is inspired by Angular, and it runs on Express or Fastify under the hood.

concepts.explanation: Group controllers and providers by feature.
Handle incoming requests with decorated methods.
Decide whether a request may proceed.

pros: Clear structure scales to big teams
